name: Enterprise HSE, Safety, Environmental, Quality & Compliance Management

domains.name: Safety Management
domains.purpose: Safety plans, observations, hazards, controls, inspections and field safety execution.

domains.name: Incident & Near-Miss Management
domains.purpose: Incident intake, classification, investigation, root cause, corrective actions and regulatory readiness.

domains.name: JHA/JSA & Pre-Task Planning
domains.purpose: Job hazard analysis, daily pre-task plans, crew acknowledgement and changing-condition controls.

domains.name: Permits to Work
domains.purpose: Confined space, hot work, excavation, lifting, electrical and other controlled-work permits.

domains.name: Training & Competency
domains.purpose: Required training, toolbox talks, qualifications, expirations and competency verification.

domains.name: Environmental Management
domains.purpose: Environmental plans, inspections, spills, stormwater, erosion control, waste and permit obligations.

domains.name: Quality Management
domains.purpose: Inspection/test plans, hold points, NCRs, punch items, corrective action and quality records.

domains.name: Compliance & Regulatory
domains.purpose: Regulatory obligations, inspections, evidence, deadlines, citations and compliance calendars.

domains.name: Industrial Hygiene
domains.purpose: Exposure assessments, monitoring, PPE programs, respiratory/hearing controls and occupational hygiene.

domains.name: Emergency Management
domains.purpose: Emergency action plans, drills, contacts, response roles and post-event review.

domains.name: Subcontractor HSEQ
domains.purpose: Prequalification, orientation, compliance, observations, incidents and performance scorecards.

domains.name: Equipment & Fleet Safety
domains.purpose: Daily inspections, lockout/tagout interfaces, operator authorization and equipment safety controls.

domains.name: Public & Traffic Safety
domains.purpose: MOT/traffic control, public protection, pedestrian interfaces and site-access safety.

domains.name: Corrective & Preventive Action
domains.purpose: CAPA ownership, due dates, verification, recurrence monitoring and effectiveness review.

domains.name: Audit & Assurance
domains.purpose: Internal audits, field audits, management reviews, findings, evidence and closure.

domains.name: HSEQ Analytics
domains.purpose: Leading/lagging indicators, trends, risk heat maps, recurrence, quality and environmental performance.

domains.name: AI HSEQ Intelligence
domains.purpose: Evidence-grounded assistance for hazard recognition, classification, trend analysis and recommendations.

domains.name: HSEQ Digital Twin
domains.purpose: Current safety, environmental, quality and compliance state linked to projects, crews, assets and locations.

critical_governance: Stop-work authority cannot be overridden by AI
Quality hold points require authorized release
Regulatory classifications and notifications require governed review
AI recommendations require evidence, confidence and human approval for consequential action
